meta.source_note: Illustrative placeholder — quasi-cluster funding by region is not yet in the tracker's pipeline. Occasional Paper 15/2025 published quasi-cluster COUNTS by region only (see quasi_cluster_pipeline.json), not dollar figures, so there is no real quasi-cluster funding total to read yet. Modelled loosely as a share of each region's company funding that sits outside its named clusters; do not cite. Cluster funding and each region's total company funding are real (funding_by_cluster.json / funding_by_country.json) -- only the quasi-cluster split is a placeholder, pending a future data update.
